title: The Delay in the Loop: How Late Can the Answer Be Before the Gain Is Too Big

questions.question: A loop is tuned on the bench and then a filter adds 10 ms of delay. The gains are unchanged. What happens?
options: Nothing, a delay does not change the gain
It may become unstable: a delay adds no gain but adds lag that grows with frequency, and it uses up the phase margin
questions.explanation: At a proportional gain of 3000 the margin went from 71.8 degrees to -19.6 at 10 ms, and the step response grew without bound.

questions.question: Ten milliseconds of delay at fifty hertz is how many degrees of phase?
options: 180: a delay is a time, and a time at a frequency is a fraction of a turn, so it is exactly backwards at fifty hertz
questions.explanation: 360 times the frequency times the delay. It grows with frequency, which is why a fast loop is hit first.

questions.question: Each doubling of the delay cut the largest stable gain about fourfold: 3.6, 3.8, 3.9. What law is that?
options: The gain a loop can stand goes as the inverse square of its delay
questions.explanation: A loop twice as late has a quarter of the gain, and one with ten times the delay has a hundredth.

questions.question: The model predicted no limit for a loop with no delay, and the simulated loop was unstable above 341737. Why?
options: Sampling is a delay of its own, which a continuous model with a pure delay does not describe well, so with no delay it is an upper bound and not a figure
questions.explanation: A command is held between samples, on average half a sample late. With any real delay added, the prediction was within 4.5 percent.

questions.question: Why does the test compare phase margins round the circle and not directly?
options: An angle is a direction: minus 293 degrees and plus 67 are the same one, so a direct comparison fails on a correct answer
questions.explanation: The argument of a complex number is reduced to one turn and a margin computed from a formula is not. The difference is taken modulo 360.

questions.question: A delay line writes the new value before reading the oldest. What does it return?
options: The value it has just stored, which is no delay at all
The value from n samples ago, correctly
questions.explanation: Read before writing. The error shows only at the edges, which is why the test checks the first outputs, a single sample gone round many times, and the wire.
